nodes.doc: the seed: writes the start mark first, whatever follows, then prints the instructions, the always-set and the first prompt's matches
nodes.label: ① sandman recall

nodes.doc: writes start and end marks today; not built yet: one line per tool call or typed prompt, once recall and take write start and end
nodes.label: sandman mark

nodes.doc: the agent's write: one trace at once, homed as encode homes one; recall lists it at once, marked ~, the episode's encode takes it as already remembered, consolidate as any trace
nodes.label: sandman remember

nodes.doc: ignores a session with no start mark; skips, holds for a job, finds it gone, or renames the transcript into the archive; marks the end with its outcome; serve's tick takes a held one once its job is gone, and ends one that never ran take
nodes.label: ② sandman take

nodes.doc: serve's tick, one episode at a time: skips a headless one, else a headless model (Claude Opus by default, $SANDMAN_ENCODER so a local model can replace it) reads the archived transcript's digest, what the session already remembered listed as done, and writes its traces, each for the bank of the repository it is about, else the cwd's; flagged so it is never taken or encoded itself
nodes.label: ③ serve · encode

nodes.doc: serve's tick, one quiet bank at a time when no episode waits: a headless model ($SANDMAN_CONSOLIDATOR) reads the bank's traces and memories and answers keep, merge or prune per trace and prune per memory; applied with no approval, everything it replaces moved to .pruned/; it takes the place of the dream pass
nodes.label: ④ serve · consolidate

nodes.doc: archived transcripts, <HHMMSS>-…-<session>.jsonl in a day dir
nodes.label: .archive/claude/<yyyy>/<mm>/<dd>/

nodes.doc: every mod event, one per line, by UTC day: start, end, call, prompt (today start and end only); and the daemon's encode

nodes.doc: the long-term store: memory files with flat frontmatter, <type>_<slug>.md

nodes.doc: what consolidate moved aside, recoverable: consumed traces, merged and pruned memories as they stood, each reply
